headline: Give Home Assistant an online voice
intro: Edge TTS adds a Home Assistant text-to-speech entity backed by Microsoft Edge's online read-aloud voices. Choose a default voice, then use it in TTS calls or as the speech engine for Assist.
highlights: Choose a default voice from a list grouped by language; the list loads at startup and refreshes daily.
Set voice, speaking rate, pitch, and volume as defaults or override them for an individual speech call.
Speech is generated online, so each call needs internet access; only the text you speak is sent to Microsoft.

flow.title: From voice choice to speech
stages: Add Edge TTS and choose a default voice
Select Edge TTS for TTS calls or Assist
Send text with optional voice and delivery settings
